message.content: {"question":"The force F=-k(xi+yj+zk) acts on a point particle of mass m=0.02kg. What work the force does to move the mass from the origin of the coordinates to point A(2,-1,2) knowing that k=2N/m and the values of the coordinates of point A are in meters.","options":{"A":"(a) 3 J","B":"(b) To answer it is necessary to specify the path traveled to go from the origin to point A.","C":"(c) 9 J","D":"(d) 0 J because the force is conservative."},"correct":"C"}
